desc:
Spawn or Create your own nextbot!

This game is still in beta, so expect many bugs. Feedbacks to improve it are welcomed.

- Update Log-

Nextbot AI is better now!

-Fixed bugs-

Fixed menu and admin panel not being able to click

Controls

Pc
Hold shift to sprint
Jump while sprinting to go faster/ Bhop
Press R to go to the sandbox menu
(Spawn Objects and Nextbots)
Press V to change perspective

Mobile
Press 'Sprint' button to toggle sprinting On or Off
Press 'Menu' button to open the sandbox menu
Press 'Change Camera' to change perspective



Private servers are free, so you don't have to play in chaotic public servers.

Once again, this game is new so expect bugs. Feedback is welcomed whether it is positive or negative. 


Inspired by Gary's Mod
